title: Certify uninterpreted functions into arrays in Lean via the clause log
summary: Uninterpreted functions that return an array, such as (declare-fun h (Index) (Array Index Element)), are now certified on the clause-log path and kernel-checked in Lean. Each Lean array type gets one universally quantified function family, and rfl facts let grind compare applications by congruence, with no new axioms.
